name: Question 4
problem:
$$
A=[\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ -1 & 1 \\ -1 & 0\end{aligned}],\,b=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 0\end{aligned}],\,W=[\begin{aligned}3 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 2 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 2\end{aligned}]
$$

Consider the matrices $A$ and $W,$ and the vector $b$ above. If the normal equation for the corresponding weighted least-squares problem $W\,Ax=Wb$ is given by

$$
[\begin{aligned}a & 23 \\ 23 & b\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}c \\ 23\end{aligned}]
$$

what is the value of $a+b+c?$
worked_solution:
To get the normal equation corresponding to $W\,Ax=Wb,$ we pre-multiply both sides of the equation by $(W\,A)^{T}:$

$$
\begin{aligned}(W\,A)^{T}\cdot W\,Ax & =(W\,A)^{T}\cdot Wb \\ {A}^{T}({W}^{T}W)Ax & ={A}^{T}({W}^{T}W)b\end{aligned}
$$

Now, since

$$
{W}^{T}W=[\begin{aligned}{3}^{2} & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & {2}^{2} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & {2}^{2}\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}9 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}],
$$

our normal equation can be written as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -1 \\ 3 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}9 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 & 3 \\ -1 & 1 \\ -1 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -1 \\ 3 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}9 & 0 & 0 \\ 0 & 4 & 0 \\ 0 & 0 & 4\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}1 \\ -1 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -1 \\ 3 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}9 & 27 \\ -4 & 4 \\ -4 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}1 & -1 & -1 \\ 3 & 1 & 0\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}9 \\ -4 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\ [\begin{aligned}17 & 23 \\ 23 & 85\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}{x}_{1} \\ {x}_{2}\end{aligned}] & =[\begin{aligned}13 \\ 23\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=17+85+13=115.
$$

A=[13−11−10],b=[1−10],W=[300020002]

Consider the matrices A and W, and the vector b above. If the normal equation for the corresponding weighted least-squares problem WAx=Wb is given by

[a2323b][x1x2]=[c23]

what is the value of a+b+c?

a
83
b
125
c
30

155

115
Submit
Incorrect
EXPLANATION

To get the normal equation corresponding to WAx=Wb, we pre-multiply both sides of the equation by (WA)T:

(WA)T⋅WAx=(WA)T⋅WbAT(WTW)Ax=AT(WTW)b

Now, since

WTW=[320002200022]=[900040004],

our normal equation can be written as follows:

[1−1−1310][900040004][13−11−10][x1x2]=[1−1−1310][900040004][1−10][1−1−1310][927−44−40][x1x2]=[1−1−1310][9−40][17232385][x1x2]=[1323]

Therefore, we have

a+b+c=17+85+13=115.
